body: Yeah you are right. I was being a bit picky here because vacuole is not the active location, its where it's degraded. So normally, it wouldn't be GO annotated. ATM, I kept the vacuole location for pho84 &pho842 until I can annotate them as a targets of the catabolic pathway. So I shouldn't  really object to the ARBA annotation, although it will be removed eventually...
